en.title: Campaign ${campaign_id}: ${basis_name}
en.level.confirmatory: Conclusion level: confirmatory. Every condition for a confirmatory conclusion holds (analysis.json, conclusion_level).
en.level.exploratory: Conclusion level: exploratory. Conditions not met: ${failed}.
en.cond.sample_size_reached: planned number of labelled trials reached in every arm
en.cond.no_peeks: no look at the comparison before the end
en.cond.reviewed_basis: label basis reviewed by a person
en.cond.schedule_allows: schedule other than blocked or interleaved
en.basis.automatic_note: These rates are automatic verdicts that no person reviewed.
en.coverage.arm: - ${arm}: ${labelled} of ${valid} valid trials have a label on this basis (${coverage}); the ${unlabelled} without one are left out of the rates.
en.coverage.warning: Warning: label coverage differs between arms by ${gap}, more than 10 percentage points.
en.layout.cards: Initial conditions: layout cards, paired by card and round; ${deviated} trials deviated from their card (kept, and analysed again without them).
en.layout.none: Initial conditions: set by a reset policy; the arms are not paired.
en.reset.treatment: The treatment includes the reset policy (it differs between arms).
en.counts.arm: - ${arm}: ${valid} valid, ${discarded} discarded, ${incomplete} incomplete, ${reruns} from reruns, ${unconfirmed} without a confirmed card, ${missing} planned slots missing.
en.results.blinded: Per-arm results are blinded until the campaign completes.
en.conclusion.confirmatory_excludes_zero: ${prefix} Under the pre-registered analysis, the ${basis_name} of ${b} is ${direction} than that of ${a} by ${delta_abs} (difference ${delta}, 95% CI [${low}, ${high}]; Holm-adjusted p = ${p_holm}).
en.conclusion.exploratory_excludes_zero: ${prefix} The data suggest that the ${basis_name} of ${b} is ${direction} than that of ${a} (difference ${delta}, 95% CI [${low}, ${high}]; Holm-adjusted p = ${p_holm}); a pre-registered independent evaluation is needed to confirm this.
en.conclusion.includes_zero: ${prefix} These data cannot tell ${a} and ${b} apart (difference ${delta}, 95% CI [${low}, ${high}]); with ${n} trials per arm this design detects, at 80% power, a difference of about ${mdd} or more.
en.conclusion.includes_zero_no_mdd: ${prefix} These data cannot tell ${a} and ${b} apart (difference ${delta}, 95% CI [${low}, ${high}]); with ${n} trials per arm this design cannot detect any difference at 80% power.
en.reason.no_pairs: no pair of trials on the same card in the same round has a label on this basis in both arms
en.reason.no_trials: an arm has no labelled trials
en.comparison.paired_detail: McNemar exact p = ${p_exact} (mid-p ${p_mid}) over ${n} pairs; paired bootstrap interval [${b_low}, ${b_high}].
en.comparison.unpaired_detail: Fisher exact p = ${p}; ${n_b} and ${n_a} trials; initial conditions were not paired.
en.comparison.deviated: Without the deviated trials: difference ${delta}, 95% CI [${low}, ${high}], ${n} pairs (sensitivity analysis).
en.omnibus.line: ${prefix} Across all ${k} arms, Cochran's Q permutation p = ${p} over ${blocks} complete blocks.
en.drift.warning: Drift warning: ${raised}. Every conclusion is exploratory.
en.drift.none: No drift diagnostic raised a warning.
en.agreement.arm: - ${arm}, ${stratum}: verdict and operator agree on ${agree} of ${judged} judged trials (${rate}; 95% interval ${low} to ${high}); Cohen's kappa ${kappa}.
en.agreement.arm_empty: - ${arm}, ${stratum}: no judged trial with an operator label.
en.agreement.carry: Only the full-step-budget agreement carries over to unattended runs; the other strata are reported apart.
en.agreement.judge_warning: Warning: the judge's error rate differs between arms (permutation p = ${p}); part of a difference in automatic-verdict rates may come from the judge.
en.power.line: With ${n} trials per arm (two-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power, baseline ${baseline}) the smallest detectable difference is about ${paired} for paired and ${unpaired} for unpaired trials.
en.power.none: With ${n} trials per arm (two-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power, baseline ${baseline}) this design cannot detect any difference.
en.power.note: Post-hoc power is not reported. power.csv lists other sample sizes.
en.limit.sample: - Sample size: ${n} trials per arm; differences smaller than about ${mdd} are not reliably detected.
en.limit.sample_none: - Sample size: ${n} trials per arm is too few to detect any difference at 80% power.
en.limit.basis_automatic: - Label basis: automatic verdicts that no person reviewed.
en.limit.coverage: - Label coverage ranges from ${low} to ${high} across arms.
en.limit.judge: - The judge's error rate may differ between arms; see agreement.csv.
en.limit.layout: - Layout cards fix the placement, not the lighting, the temperature or the robot's state; ${deviated} trials deviated from their card.
en.limit.layout_none: - Initial conditions were not paired between arms.
en.limit.scope: - One task on one robot: the results say nothing beyond them.
en.limit.early_stop: - An early stop ends an episode before failures that might have followed; only control episodes show them.
en.limit.reruns: - ${reruns} trials came from reruns after an interruption; ${discarded} episodes were discarded.
en.limit.survival: - Time to success treats fault and operator stops as censoring (they are competing events).
en.limit.unconfirmed: - ${unconfirmed} trials without a confirmed card are left out of the paired analysis.

zh-CN.title: 评测计划 ${campaign_id}：${basis_name}
zh-CN.level.confirmatory: 结论等级：确证性。确证性结论的全部条件都满足（analysis.json 的 conclusion_level）。
zh-CN.level.exploratory: 结论等级：探索性。未满足的条件：${failed}。
zh-CN.cond.sample_size_reached: 每组带标签的试验数达到计划值
zh-CN.cond.no_peeks: 结束前没有查看比较结果
zh-CN.cond.schedule_allows: 顺序策略不是整组连跑或固定交替
zh-CN.cond.powered_design: 预设差值在 80% 功效下可检出
zh-CN.basis.automatic_note: 这些比率来自自动判定，没有经过人工核实。
zh-CN.basis.mixed_counts: 使用的标签：裁定 ${adjudicated} 条，操作员 ${operator} 条。
zh-CN.coverage.arm: - ${arm}：${valid} 个有效试验中有 ${labelled} 个带本口径的标签（${coverage}）；没有标签的 ${unlabelled} 个不进入成功率。
zh-CN.coverage.warning: 警告：各组标签覆盖率相差 ${gap}，超过 10 个百分点。
zh-CN.layout.cards: 初始条件：布局卡，按卡和轮次成对；${deviated} 个试验偏离了卡片（保留，并另做一次剔除它们的分析）。
zh-CN.layout.none: 初始条件：由复位策略设置；各组不成对。
zh-CN.reset.treatment: 处理因素包含复位策略（各组不同）。
zh-CN.counts.arm: - ${arm}：有效 ${valid}，作废 ${discarded}，不完整 ${incomplete}，补跑 ${reruns}，卡号未确认 ${unconfirmed}，缺失卡位 ${missing}。
zh-CN.results.blinded: 评测计划完成前不显示各组结果。
zh-CN.conclusion.confirmatory_excludes_zero: ${prefix}在预注册的分析下，${b} 的${basis_name}比 ${a} ${direction} ${delta_abs}（差值 ${delta}，95% CI [${low}, ${high}]；Holm 校正 p=${p_holm}）。
zh-CN.conclusion.exploratory_excludes_zero: ${prefix}探索性结果显示 ${b} 的${basis_name}${direction}于 ${a}（差值 ${delta}，95% CI [${low}, ${high}]；Holm 校正 p=${p_holm}），需要预注册的独立评测确认。
zh-CN.conclusion.includes_zero: ${prefix}本次数据不足以区分 ${a} 与 ${b}（差值 ${delta}，95% CI [${low}, ${high}]）；每组 ${n} 次时，本设计在 80% 功效下的最小可检出差约为 ${mdd}。
zh-CN.conclusion.includes_zero_no_mdd: ${prefix}本次数据不足以区分 ${a} 与 ${b}（差值 ${delta}，95% CI [${low}, ${high}]）；每组 ${n} 次时，本设计在 80% 功效下检不出任何差值。
zh-CN.reason.no_pairs: 没有同一轮、同一张卡上两组都带本口径标签的试验对
zh-CN.reason.no_trials: 某组没有带标签的试验
zh-CN.comparison.paired_detail: McNemar 精确检验 p=${p_exact}（mid-p ${p_mid}），共 ${n} 对；成对 bootstrap 区间 [${b_low}, ${b_high}]。
zh-CN.comparison.unpaired_detail: Fisher 精确检验 p=${p}；两组分别 ${n_b} 和 ${n_a} 个试验；初始条件不成对。
zh-CN.comparison.deviated: 剔除偏离试验后：差值 ${delta}，95% CI [${low}, ${high}]，${n} 对（敏感性分析）。
zh-CN.omnibus.line: ${prefix}全部 ${k} 组的 Cochran Q 置换检验 p=${p}，共 ${blocks} 个完整区组。
zh-CN.drift.warning: 漂移警告：${raised}。所有结论都按探索性处理。
zh-CN.agreement.arm: - ${arm}，${stratum}：${judged} 个已判定试验中判定与操作员一致 ${agree} 个（${rate}；95% 区间 ${low} 至 ${high}）；Cohen κ=${kappa}。
zh-CN.agreement.arm_empty: - ${arm}，${stratum}：没有带操作员标签的已判定试验。
zh-CN.agreement.carry: 只有完整步数组的一致率可以外推到无人值守运行；其余分层分开报告。
zh-CN.agreement.judge_warning: 警告：判定器的误判率在各组之间不同（置换检验 p=${p}）；自动判定成功率的组间差异可能部分来自判定器。
zh-CN.power.line: 每组 ${n} 次（双侧 α=0.05、80% 功效、基线 ${baseline}）时，最小可检出差约为：成对 ${paired}，不成对 ${unpaired}。
zh-CN.power.none: 每组 ${n} 次（双侧 α=0.05、80% 功效、基线 ${baseline}）时检不出任何差值。
zh-CN.power.note: 不报告事后功效。其他样本量见 power.csv。
zh-CN.limit.sample: - 样本量：每组 ${n} 次；小于约 ${mdd} 的差值不能可靠检出。
zh-CN.limit.sample_none: - 样本量：每组 ${n} 次太少，在 80% 功效下检不出任何差值。
zh-CN.limit.basis_automatic: - 标签口径：自动判定，没有经过人工核实。
zh-CN.limit.coverage: - 各组标签覆盖率在 ${low} 到 ${high} 之间。
zh-CN.limit.judge: - 判定器的误判率可能因组而异；见 agreement.csv。
zh-CN.limit.layout: - 布局卡只控制摆放，不控制光照、温度和机器人状态；${deviated} 个试验偏离了卡片。
zh-CN.limit.layout_none: - 各组的初始条件没有配对。
zh-CN.limit.scope: - 单任务、单台机器人：结果不能推广到它们之外。
zh-CN.limit.early_stop: - 早停会在之后可能出现的失败之前结束片段；只有对照片段能显示这些失败。
zh-CN.limit.reruns: - ${reruns} 个试验来自中断后的补跑；${discarded} 个片段被作废。
zh-CN.limit.survival: - 时间到成功把故障停止和操作员停止当作删失（它们是竞争事件）。
zh-CN.limit.unconfirmed: - ${unconfirmed} 个卡号未确认的试验不进入成对分析。
